meta: AI agents work fast, so their mistakes happen fast too. Three things never to let an agent do alone: pay, send messages, delete data.

muc.title: Fast mistakes
muc.text: Agents work fast, so when they're wrong, they're wrong fast too. Three things never to let one do alone: pay, send messages, delete data.

muc.title: No paying on its own
muc.text: Don't save bank cards in an account the agent uses. At checkout, you check and click yourself.

muc.title: Drafts only
muc.text: For emails and messages, the agent may only write drafts. You read them, then click send yourself.

muc.title: No deleting on its own
muc.text: To clean up files, let the agent only list what should be deleted. You press delete.

muc.title: Three guardrail lines
muc.text: Write three guardrail lines about money, messages and deleting, and paste them at the top of every agent brief.
